model.dependency: EXECUTE continuously depends on SUPPORT at hour 8; MUTD=N; DTTOL is the only semantic difference between dependent inputs
model.failure: accepted A05 stochastic system FRT=300000 operating hours with seed 1 and half-hour direct repair

system_types.SUPPORT: TEACH-AIR-01, three deployed, FRT=300000 OPHOURS, half-hour direct repair

predeclared_hypotheses: SUPPORT uses two of three TEACH-AIR-01 aircraft and EXECUTE uses one nonfailing EXEC-AIR-01; the third support aircraft is a prepared replacement. Both missions launch near scheduled hour 8 with zero converter errors and exact source-row roundtrip.

The accepted A05 parent observed a half-hour support-type suspension under this seed. The typed A14 control must independently show a finite SUPPORT suspension and resumed operation with a prepared support-aircraft replacement. Failure onset is stochastic and is not assumed to remain at the A05 timestamp.

Only support aircraft carry a failure clock. The no-dependency control and four DTTOL variants must share the same support failure and gap timing before assigning an EXECUTE difference to tolerance. If stochastic schedules still differ, this is a diagnostic.

If the observed SUPPORT gap is 0.5 hour while EXECUTE is still active, DTTOL=0 and 0.49 should abort EXECUTE before its hour-11.9 planned end; DTTOL=0.51 should preserve it through the gap. The DTTOL=0.5 exact boundary is measured without preassigning event order.

For every accepted run, independently reconcile failure, preparation, suspension, dependency and mission events with 32 aligned half-hour system/stock bins, success factors and terminal readiness. Any changed failure schedule, absent overlap, converter error or unsupported dependency result makes this five-run comparison a diagnostic.
limits: One seed and one stochastic failure onset; this cannot prove a general DTTOL law or deterministic failure timing.
No other DTTOL values, multiple precedents, cross-unit or profile dependence, GUI visual behavior or cross-engine equivalence.

excluded_diagnostics.reason: Dependency changed which aircraft failed; SUPPORT gap absent in dependent runs.
